## Common WHERE Filters

### 分区过滤（必选）

```sql
-- 单日昨日（性能分析、时延分析）
WHERE grass_date = date_add(current_date(), -1)

-- 近 1 月范围（来源分布分析）
WHERE grass_date >= date_add('month', -1, current_date)
  AND grass_date <= date_add('day', -1, current_date)
```

### 地区过滤

```sql
-- 标准 8 区 + OTHER（来源分布）
AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR', 'OTHER')

-- 标准 8 区（性能分析）
AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'OTHER')

-- BR 延迟支持（充值漏斗 — 单独的日期映射）
AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'TH', 'VN', 'PH', 'SG', 'TW', 'MY', 'BR')
```

### 时区过滤（必选）

```sql
AND tz_type = 'local'
```

### 页面类型过滤（核心维度）

```sql
-- Ads 首页
AND page_type = 'seller_center_shopee_ads'

-- 充值页面
AND page_type = 'seller_center_top_up'

-- Checkout 页面
AND page_type = 'seller_center_value_added_service_checkout'

-- 广告详情页（商品/店铺/直播）
AND page_type = 'seller_center_product_ad_detail'
AND page_type = 'seller_center_shop_ad_detail'
AND page_type = 'seller_center_livestream_ad_detail'

-- 广告创建页
AND page_type = 'seller_center_create_product_ads'
AND page_type = 'seller_center_create_shop_ads'
AND page_type = 'seller_center_create_display_ads'  -- Brand

-- 奖励中心
AND page_type = 'seller_center_shopee_ads_rewards_page'
```

### 用户行为日期约束

-- 限制用户行为发生时间和数据落库在同一天
AND date_format(from_unixtime(event_timestamp / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d')
    = date_format(date_add('day', -1, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d')
```

FROM traffic.sellercenter_dwd_view_di__reg_live a
LEFT JOIN xxx_dim_tab b ON a.user_id = b.user_id
WHERE ...;
```

### JOIN 2: 自关联做漏斗分析（充值漏斗）

同一张 view 表自关联，检查用户后续页面访问：

```sql
-- 从充值页面(top_up) → checkout 页面
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT min(from_unixtime(c.event_timestamp/1000))
    FROM traffic.sellercenter_dwd_view_di__reg_live c
    WHERE c.grass_date = ...
      AND c.page_type = 'seller_center_value_added_service_checkout'
      AND c.tz_type = 'local'
      AND c.shop_id = tpv.shop_id
      AND from_unixtime(c.event_timestamp/1000) > tpv.topup_page_visit_time
) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reached_checkout
```

## Common Aggregations

### 1. 来源分布聚合

```sql
-- 按日期+地区+来源聚合 PV
SELECT
    grass_date,
    grass_region,
    json_extract_scalar(data, '$.source_page_id') AS source_page_id,
    COUNT(*) AS pv
FROM traffic.sellercenter_dwd_view_di__reg_live
WHERE grass_date >= date_add('month', -1, current_date)
  AND grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'OTHER', 'BR')
  AND page_type = 'seller_center_shopee_ads'
  AND tz_type = 'local'
GROUP BY grass_date, grass_region, json_extract_scalar(data, '$.source_page_id');
```

### 2. 前端性能聚合（分桶统计）

```sql
-- 按 region + 性能分桶统计店铺数和达标率
SELECT
    grass_region,
    module_to_enter_bucket,
    COUNT(DISTINCT shop_id) AS total_shop_cnt,
    AVG(module_to_mounted_time) AS avg_module_to_mounted,
    PERCENTILE(CAST(module_to_mounted_time AS BIGINT), 0.5) AS p50_module_to_mounted,
    PERCENTILE(CAST(module_to_mounted_time AS BIGINT), 0.9) AS p90_module_to_mounted,
    SUM(is_performance_qualified_3s) AS qualified_shop_cnt_3s,
    SUM(is_performance_qualified_3s) * 100.0 / COUNT(shop_id) AS qualified_rate_3s
FROM performance_buckets
GROUP BY grass_region, module_to_enter_bucket, ...;
```

### 3. Click-to-View 时延聚合

```sql
-- 统计首次点击后 3s/5s/10s/30s 内的浏览命中
SELECT
    target_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT shop_id) AS shop_cnt,
    SUM(view_after_1clk_in_3s) AS view_after_1clk_in_3s_shop_cnt,
    SUM(view_after_1clk_in_5s) AS view_after_1clk_in_5s_shop_cnt,
    SUM(view_after_1clk_in_10s) AS view_after_1clk_in_10s_shop_cnt,
    SUM(view_after_1clk_in_30s) AS view_after_1clk_in_30s_shop_cnt,
    SUM(view_after_1clk_in_3s) * 100.00 / COUNT(shop_id) AS pct_in_3s,
    SUM(view_after_1clk_in_5s) * 100.00 / COUNT(shop_id) AS pct_in_5s
FROM clk_view_gap
GROUP BY target_type;
```

### 4. 充值漏斗聚合（多步骤转化）

```sql
-- 按 source_page_id 统计充值漏斗各步骤 PV 和转化率
SELECT
    source_page_id,
    COUNT(*) AS step1_total_visits,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN reached_checkout = 1 THEN 1 END) AS step2_checkout_visits,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN topup_success = 1 THEN 1 END) AS step3_success_visits,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN reached_checkout = 1 THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE)
          / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS step1_to_step2_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN topup_success = 1 THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE)
          / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS overall_rate,
    SUM(CASE WHEN topup_success = 1 THEN topup_amt_usd ELSE 0 END) AS total_topup_usd
FROM funnel_data
GROUP BY source_page_id;
```

### Snippet 3: 性能分桶 + 达标判定（shop_detail_spark）

```sql
SELECT
    grass_region,
    shop_id,
    CASE
        WHEN module_to_enter_time <= 1000 THEN '0-1s'
        WHEN module_to_enter_time <= 3000 THEN '1-3s'
        WHEN module_to_enter_time <= 5000 THEN '3-5s'
        WHEN module_to_enter_time <= 10000 THEN '5-10s'
        ELSE '10s+'
    END AS module_to_enter_bucket,
    CASE
        WHEN module_to_mounted_time <= 3000 THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS is_performance_qualified_3s,
    CASE
        WHEN module_to_mounted_time <= 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS is_performance_qualified_5s
FROM detail_shop_ads_ads_performance_1st;
```

### Snippet 4: Click-to-View 时延计算逻辑

```sql
-- 从 click 表获取首次点击后，检查 view 表是否有对应时间窗内的浏览
navi_leadpage_shop_view_list AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(a.shop_id, b.shop_id) AS shop_id,
        event_timestamp AS view_event_timestamp,
        CASE
            WHEN page_type = 'seller_center_shopee_ads' THEN 'Marketing Centre/Shopee Ads'
            WHEN page_type = 'seller_center_my_order' THEN 'Order/My Orders'
            ...
        END AS target_type
    FROM traffic.sellercenter_dwd_view_di__reg_live a
    LEFT JOIN shop_dim_tab b ON a.user_id = b.user_id
    WHERE
        a.grass_date = date_add('day', -1, current_date)
        AND a.grass_region IN ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'OTHER')
        AND a.tz_type = 'local'
)

-- 检查 3s/5s/10s/30s 是否有浏览
MAX(CASE
    WHEN t2.view_event_timestamp BETWEEN t1.clk_event_timestamp
         AND t1.clk_event_timestamp_3s THEN 1 ELSE 0
END) AS view_after_1clk_in_3s
```

### Snippet 5: 充值漏斗 — 页面访问提取（topup_funnel_analysis_di）

```sql
topup_page_visits AS (
    SELECT
        rdm.target_date AS grass_date,
        sr.dim_grass_region AS resolved_grass_region,
        json_extract_scalar(t.data, '$.source_page_id') AS source_page_id,
        t.shop_id,
        t.user_id,
        t.event_id,
        from_unixtime(t.event_timestamp/1000) AS topup_page_visit_time
    FROM traffic.sellercenter_dwd_view_di__reg_live t
    INNER JOIN shop_regions sr ON t.shop_id = sr.shop_id
    INNER JOIN region_date_mapping rdm ON sr.dim_grass_region = rdm.grass_region
    WHERE t.grass_date = rdm.target_date
        AND t.page_type = 'seller_center_top_up'
        AND t.tz_type = 'local'
        AND t.shop_id IS NOT NULL
        AND t.event_id IS NOT NULL
)
```

### Snippet 6: 漏斗自关联 — 检查后续 checkout（topup_funnel_analysis_di）

```sql
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT min(from_unixtime(c.event_timestamp/1000))
    FROM traffic.sellercenter_dwd_view_di__reg_live c
    WHERE c.grass_date = ...
        AND c.page_type = 'seller_center_value_added_service_checkout'
        AND c.tz_type = 'local'
        AND c.shop_id = tpv.shop_id
        AND c.grass_region = tpv.resolved_grass_region
        AND from_unixtime(c.event_timestamp/1000) > tpv.topup_page_visit_time
) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reached_checkout
```

### Snippet 7: 充值成功检验（topup_funnel_analysis_di）

```sql
CASE WHEN (
    SELECT min(CAST(s.topup_create_datetime AS TIMESTAMP))
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertiser_credit_topup_df__reg_s0_live s
    WHERE s.grass_date >= rdm.target_date
        AND s.order_type = 6
        AND s.topup_amt_usd > 0
        AND s.shop_id = tpv.shop_id
        AND CAST(s.topup_create_datetime AS TIMESTAMP) > tpv.topup_page_visit_time
) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS topup_success
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

以下为基于此表派生的计算指标（从多文件中提取）：

### 前端性能指标

```sql
-- 页面加载各阶段耗时（毫秒）
module_to_enter_time = CAST(get_json_object(data, '$.module_to_enter') AS BIGINT)
enter_to_mounted_time = CAST(get_json_object(data, '$.enter_to_mounted') AS BIGINT)
module_to_mounted_time = CAST(get_json_object(data, '$.module_to_mounted') AS BIGINT)

-- 3s 达标率 = 3s 内完成加载的店铺数 / 有数据的店铺总数
qualified_rate_3s = SUM(is_performance_qualified_3s) * 100.0 / COUNT(shop_id)
```

### Click-to-View 时延指标

```sql
-- X 秒窗口内浏览命中数
view_after_1clk_in_Xs = MAX(CASE
    WHEN view_event_timestamp BETWEEN clk_event_timestamp AND clk_event_timestamp_Xs
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

-- X 秒窗口内浏览命中率
pct_in_Xs = SUM(view_after_1clk_in_Xs) * 100.0 / COUNT(shop_id)
```

### 充值漏斗转化指标

```sql
-- 各步骤到达标记
reached_checkout = EXISTS(后续 checkout 页面浏览记录)
topup_success = EXISTS(后续充值成功记录 AND topup_amt_usd > 0)

-- 步骤转化率
step1_to_step2_rate = step2_checkout_visits / NULLIF(step1_total_visits, 0)
step2_to_step3_rate = step3_success_visits / NULLIF(step2_checkout_visits, 0)
overall_rate = step3_success_visits / NULLIF(step1_total_visits, 0)

-- 失败率 = (总访问 - 成功) / 总访问
failure_rate = (step1_total_visits - success_orders) / NULLIF(step1_total_visits, 0)
```
